title: Anthropic Artifacts
principles: interactive artifacts are useful for fast iteration
artifact workflow benefits from preserved lineage and review checkpoints
anti_patterns: treating a fast prototype as a finished design system
assuming interactive output is automatically visually coherent
foundry_implications: require prompt-trace artifacts for fixture review
separate artifact speed from design quality scoring

title: Turn ideas into interactive AI-powered apps
principles: rapid interactive prototyping needs a stronger review loop
artifact generation should preserve intent through iteration
anti_patterns: shipping the first generated structure without critique
foundry_implications: score interaction quality separately from visual direction
treat prototype iteration as evidence, not as the final quality signal

title: From idea to app: Introducing Stitch, a new way to design UIs
principles: UI generation works better with structured intent
generated interfaces should stay connected to a design workflow
anti_patterns: calling the remote generator before the design state is ready
treating screen output as production truth
foundry_implications: keep design prep ahead of generation
use prompt traces and final handoff artifacts for review

title: Introducing A2UI: An open project for agent-driven interfaces
principles: agent-generated interfaces need explicit task context and boundaries
interface generation should preserve observable structure and state
anti_patterns: opaque UI generation with no provenance
state changes that do not reveal clear user-facing feedback
foundry_implications: add provenance and state quality to the scoring rubric
treat untraceable style drift as a harness failure

title: AI-powered prototyping with design systems
principles: design-system context improves generated UI consistency
shared tokens and primitives reduce default-style drift
anti_patterns: asking for beautiful UI without system constraints
letting a tool default to its own visual bias
foundry_implications: tie every scenario to explicit direction, motif, and layout ids
score unexplained default-style fallback as a gap

title: Inside Figma: A retrospective on Make Designs
principles: design generation needs stronger review and selection discipline
good output depends on structured constraints more than novelty
anti_patterns: reviewing outcomes without a scenario contract
foundry_implications: use fixed manifests instead of freeform prompt tests
preserve a clear review path from prompt trace to scorecard

title: A designer's framework for better AI prompts
principles: prompt structure should name constraints, priorities, and exclusions
better prompts define what should not happen as well as what should
anti_patterns: using generic style words with no operational meaning
foundry_implications: require anti-slop constraints on every scenario
record excluded cliches inside prompt-trace artifacts

title: Design Prompts
principles: style libraries help compare clear visual directions
named styles make it easier to discuss exclusions and motifs
anti_patterns: copying raw prompt payloads into Foundry runtime flows
using external style presets as the sole design system
foundry_implications: translate style presets into dataset entries with source metadata
use Design Prompts as vocabulary intake only
